name: B10-0225/2024 (ESN) – Human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on human rights in Kyrgyzstan. It welcomes closer EU trade and cooperation ties and a new Kyrgyz law against domestic and sexual violence. It says every country may act against foreign interference and oversee foreign funding of non-governmental organisations. It notes the arrest of opposition leader Temirlan Sultanbekov and two party members on vote-buying charges, and the disqualification of the party's municipal candidates. The text asks for nothing binding; it is a statement of position.

- No legal change: Parliament only states positions on Kyrgyzstan.
- Affects EU-Kyrgyzstan relations and the arrested opposition figures.
- Next: the text is sent to EU institutions and member states.
